vectors.name: a-vanished-subhash-id-is-not-a-dropped-block-stay
vectors.note: SPEC.md §16 mandatory reader rule (v1.6): a tool MUST NOT report a marker carrying the exact `subhash` key as the stay of the block containing it. The key is compared exactly, without segmenting or resolving a child, so a tool that implements neither §5.5 nor §5.6 still applies it. The list and the doomed paragraph both vanish. Only `b2` is a dropped block stay; `c1` never was one, so an implementation whose block id index still admits `subhash` markers reports two DROPPED_IDs here and sends a caller looking for a block that never existed.
